exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f on a finite uniform cube and physical block B, K(f)=integral J_f=(H_nat(f)-p_empty ln(1/p_empty))/2 obeys 2[K(f)-E_y K(f_y)]=M_B^+ + C_B^+ + ell_B, where q_T=sum_{U subset B}p_{U union T}=E_y p_y(T), M_T=sum_U p_{U union T}ln(q_T/p_{U union T}), C_T=E_y p_y(T)ln(p_y(T)/q_T), plus omits T=empty, and ell_B=sum_{nonempty U subset B}p_U ln(1/p_U). All three terms are nonnegative. For B={i}, C_i^+<=2 Inf_i and ell_i<=(2/e)Inf_i. The identity telescopes in every finite physical stopping tree, with retained terminal K and cumulative channel-plus-level cost <=(2+2/e)[I(f)-E I(leaf)]. If R_nat=sum_i M_i^+ and B_nat=sum_i H_nat(S_i|S_without_i), then 0<=B_nat-R_nat<=(1+2/e)I. Moreover R_nat(y product_{j=1}^m g(x^(j)))=m B_nat(g) and I=m I(g)+1, so the optimal universal constants for R_nat/I and B_nat/I are equal. A universal R_nat<=A I implies FEI in bits with constant (A+2)/ln2 via C018; no such A is proved here.

For F_{a,r}=Addr_a-2 indicator{all inputs +1} with a>=1, k=a+2^a, r>=1, D=k+r and delta=2^(-D), and any b padding coordinates, 1<=b<=r, the exact signed three-class row formulas (9)-(11) of DERIVATION.md compute the heat drop, conditional erasure, channel and level mass. For fixed a,b as r grows, M_B/I_B and C_B/I_B tend to 2ln2 and the heat-drop ratio tends to 2ln2. For b=r, rho=4^a/2^k, the erasure/channel limits are 2(1+rho)ln2 and 2(1-rho)ln2, the heat limit remains 2ln2, and the lost-level limit is 4ln2/2^k. All limits are analytic, not finite-grid extrapolations.
